alerts.title: Acute Kidney Injury
alerts.message: Guidelines state to check creatinine in patients on TDF admitted to hospital, especially with dehydration or sepsis. Patient has severe gastroenteritis with dehydration and acute kidney injury (creatinine 2.4, was 0.9). TDF may be a contributing factor, but dehydration and sepsis are also likely causes.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor creatinine and adjust TDF as needed
